verdict.rationale: Dynadot's own docs claim search and registration across over 600 domain extensions, plus IDN search, which covers the 'hundreds of extensions' half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents per-TLD special requirements such as restricted-TLD eligibility or country-code rules. Missing for 10: per-TLD documentation of restricted/ccTLD requirements, explicit evidence of ccTLD and restricted-TLD coverage, independent corroboration of the 600+ extension catalog.

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD

citations.quote: Search, discover, and register from over 600 domain extensions.
Search available Internationalized Domain Names (IDNs) and register today.
